bio:
## About

I am a third-year Software Engineering undergraduate at SLIIT, based in Colombo.
Most of what I build is full-stack and production-shaped: real authentication,
real payment flows, real failure handling. I care less about how many projects
exist and more about whether each one would survive contact with actual users.

### What I work on

The visible half is web engineering — TypeScript and Next.js on the front,
Node.js and Express REST APIs behind it, PostgreSQL or MongoDB underneath,
containerised and deployed through CI. That covers an AI speech-coaching
platform running in production, a dual-market e-commerce platform with
token-rotation auth and idempotent payment webhooks, and a concurrency-safe
appointment microservice inside a larger healthcare system.

Further down there is work that does not fit a standard web CV: milestone-based
escrow smart contracts in Solidity, verified on Sepolia and validated with
Foundry fuzz and invariant suites.

### How I work

I prefer problems where correctness is checkable. The appointment service
exists because double-booking under a race condition is a real bug with a real
fix — Redis holds with TTL expiry, MongoDB multi-document transactions, and a
unique compound index as the last line of defence. The e-commerce catalog
stores money as integer cents because floating-point pricing errors are not
theoretical. That instinct shows up across everything here.

### Right now

I am looking for a software engineering internship in full-stack or backend
development, and preparing for the AWS Certified Developer — Associate exam.
